name: ck12_14_percentage
description: Test 14 (CK7). The percentage factor is the float 0x37422E45 = f32(1/86400); the getters load the seconds exactly and round the product once to float. Noon gives exactly 0.5 (0x3F000000), 06:00 gives 0.25, 18:00 gives 0.75, 23:59:59 gives 0x3F7FFF3E, one second gives the factor itself. The visual getter uses the visual seconds the same way.
